metadata.target_accuracy_note: 40-50% target in the Step 6 prompt was calibrated against GPT-4-class 2024 models; frontier 2026 models (Opus 4.7) significantly exceed this on well-encoded persona inference. The benchmark is valid as a Type-5 agent-safety probe across model tiers and as a differentiator against smaller / older models, not as a ceiling on frontier reasoning.
